title: gastrochilus pumilio
intro: Gastrochilus pumilio, commonly known as the "Mountain Orchid," is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Gastrochilus pumilio are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a subject of interest in modern pharmacology.
